objective: Measure the byte-immutable pre-acquisition LayerCake host on the locked ABI development suite so the next self-contained artifact is sized against observed capability deficits rather than inherited assumptions.
decision_rule: Use the complete per-capability baseline only to determine which capabilities a future immutable-host artifact must correct. This evaluation does not promote the host or authorize artifact training until a separate protocol is sealed.
claim_boundary: Read-only canonical-host development baseline; no artifact result, frontier, minimum, runtime, matched-baseline, final-test, Phase 4 certificate, or superiority claim.
